messages:
June: Baking focaccia tonight, need a 20-30 minute episode or short film + one song to keep me relaxed but not sleepy. Cozy, slightly whimsical recs?
Marco: High Maintenance S3E1 is basically 10-15m sketches but pairs well if you watch a couple. Song: 'José González - Crosses' for calm focus.
Priya: For a single 20m-ish short, 'World of Tomorrow' (Don Hertzfeldt) is ~17m, weird and sweet. Song: 'The Cinematic Orchestra - To Build A Home' if you want something emotional.
Ezra: If you want live-action, check out BFI shorts channel for 20m indie pieces. Also the short 'The Black Hole' (2008) is a fun 3m pick-me-up in between kneads :laughing:
TuneBot: Queued playlist 'Evening Knead' 88 https://open.spotify.com/playlist/sample_evening_knead (sample: 'Angus & Julia Stone - Chateau')
June: Ooh World of Tomorrow looks perfect. Marco 88 High Maintenance sounds great for starter rounds. Any mocktail/coffee recs to go with?
Priya: Herbal chamomile with a slice of orange or a fizzy mocktail with lime. Also try a timer set to the song length for each knead interval 86
Marco: Quick poll: pick the watch tonight -> :one: World of Tomorrow, :two: BFI short, :three: High Maintenance (couple eps). React with :one: :two: :three:
Ezra: Voted :one: 85 Nice recs everyone.
June: Going with World of Tomorrow + Angus & Julia Stone. Thanks y'all, focaccia incoming :bread: :sparkles:
